title: Maximal Difference
statementMd:
You are given an array of integers $*a*_{*i*}$. Find the largest absolute value of difference between adjacent elements of the array $*max*(*abs*(*a*_{*i*} - *a*_{*i* + 1}))$.

## Input

The only line of the input contains a list of space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$) — elements of the array. The size of the array is between $2$ and $10$, inclusive. Note that the size of the array is not given explicitly!

## Output

Output a single integer — the largest absolute value of difference between adjacent elements of the array.
